rationale: Imported panels register their captured fonts through a new capability-free bridge call, registerEmbeddedFont, that reads only bytes sealed into the panel under their script-relative name; codegen emits it for faces localized beside the script and keeps the Filesystem-gated registerFont only for absolute-path faces; headless import tools seal the same files into their bridges. The change narrows what a panel can read and moves no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority.
tests: build/test/pulp-test-group-view-widgets "empty capabilities register only sealed embedded fonts"
